answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a refundable bond keyed to one funding source: each new identity must post collateral moved from a wallet that survived an independent proof-of-work window, and the registry refuses enrollment when one source seeds many claims. Faking ten thousand voters means paying the yarrow bond ten thousand times and burning that mining window ten thousand times, while an honest agent pays once. Duplicate patterns slash the bond, so mass enrollment turns negative. The sonnet of honest onboarding costs a whisper of what the attack does.
